rounds.t: Florida man hurls a live alligator through a Wendy’s drive-thru window
Australia sends soldiers with machine guns to fight emus, and loses
rounds.s: The Great Emu War, Western Australia, 1932.

rounds.t: Vermont town fines residents who fail to wave at snowplow drivers
A Minnesota town elects a dog as its mayor
rounds.s: Cormorant, Minnesota elected Duke the dog in 2014.

rounds.t: Dutch railway offers free tickets to passengers who bring a sourdough starter
A penguin is knighted by the Norwegian King’s Guard
rounds.s: Sir Nils Olav, Edinburgh Zoo’s king penguin, holds the rank of brigadier.

rounds.t: Thieves steal millions of dollars of maple syrup from a Quebec reserve
rounds.s: The Great Canadian Maple Syrup Heist, 2011 to 2012.

rounds.t: A laughter epidemic closes schools across a region of Tanzania
Ohio library begins lending out retired librarians as in-person search engines
Alaska town keeps a cat as honorary mayor for two decades
A 130-tonne fatberg clogs a London sewer, and gets put in a museum
rounds.s: Whitechapel, 2017. A chunk went to the Museum of London.

rounds.t: Hundreds of people dance for days in a French city and cannot stop
